name: Espanso
title: Espanso: free TextExpander alternative
hook: TextExpander charges you sixty bucks a year to type your repeated text for you. This app does it for free.

features.intro: Stop typing the same stuff over and over.
features.say: Type a short keyword and it swaps in your full text, in almost any app.
It fills in dates, emojis, and pop-up forms.

caption:
TextExpander Pro costs $60/year. Espanso types your snippets for you, free ⌨️

✅ Type a short keyword, get your full text in almost any app
✅ Fills in dates, emojis and pop-up forms
✅ Runs 100% on your computer, no tracking
✅ No subscription, 100% free

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ Snippets are set up in simple text (YAML) files rather than a visual editor. Wayland support on Linux is experimental

Comment "SNIPPET" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day

#opensource #github #productivity #textexpander #automation #freeapps #techtips #mac
